as_told.title: Huge red square hovers over Vandenberg launch facility

tellings.quote: The incursions began on October 14th, 2003 when Boeing contractors reported a massive glowing red square silently hovering over two missile defense sites.
tellings.difference: Gives the date as October 14, 2003, says it was red, glowing and silent over two missile defence sites, says Boeing contractors reported it, and cites Air Force records, AARO and the FBI.
tellings.link_reason: A large glowing rectangular or square object at Vandenberg in 2003, matching Shurmer's football-sized rectangle; the five-incident story is a broader series.

plain: The story is that in 2003 a huge glowing red square came in from the ocean and hovered low over Vandenberg Air Force Base in California, where the US launches missiles. A man named Ryan Graves tells it as reported by a large group of Boeing contractors. They were working near a launch facility when a red square about 100 yards on a side approached from the sea and hovered at low altitude over it. A man named Jeff Natelli gives the date as 14 October 2003. He says Boeing contractors reported a massive glowing red square silently hovering over two missile defense sites. He points to Air Force records of the event and mentions Representative Luna, the FBI, and AARO, the Pentagon office that now collects unexplained aerial reports. Even the skeptic Michael Shermer brings it up as "the one off the coast", a rectangle about the size of a football field. If true, it would mean an unknown object hovered over sensitive US military sites without being stopped.
